clauses.statement: The repository must not provide a normal GitHub Actions deployment path to the retired Lightsail mana-runtime. Recovery assets may be used only after the Cloudflare entry is stopped and an incident owner explicitly authorizes a single recovery run.
forbidden_patterns: provide a workflow_dispatch path for Lightsail deployment
restart the previous Lightsail runtime while the same Cloudflare binding is enabled
treat HTTP health or CI success as proof of production outcome
stop the Lightsail instance or unrelated services
treat unavailable queue, run, or receipt evidence as zero
